services.name: Fishing Charter
services.desc: Minutes from Seattle, Salmon Fishing right on the Puget Sound. Based in Edmonds Washington, this Year-round fishing charter minutes from Downtown Seattle not only provides Guided Salmon Fishing from Seattle to Everett Washington for winter blackmouth, spring and summer chinook, and fall coho, pinks, chums and sockeye but also offers fishing charters for Bottom Fishing and Lingcod. Puget Sound fishing offers the most spectacular surroundings for salmon fishing in the United States. All equipment, rods, reels, bait, and tackle Cleaning and bagging of your fish Captained by U.S. Coast Guard licensed skippers All boats fully licensed with Washington State Department of Fisheries and U.S. Coast
